operation.summary: Is Bridgit up, and which agent you are
operation.returns: status, app, app_version, mcp (this API's MCP server, /v1/mcp), agent_control (the second MCP server /mcp and /v2 routes for the control tools, with mode private or limited), agent, agent_id, model (what you last told POST /v1/me, or null), listener_uptime_seconds, battery_level, battery_runtime (estimated remaining/lower/upper seconds while unplugged, status and observed_seconds; learning until 10 minutes and 2% drain), charging, bind_address, port, base_url (the address to use for every call), owner_email (the same status as GET /v1/owner/email), api_revision, whats_new (API changes since the revision you last saw), links (where to read more)
